statement: The subgroup fixture was checked and ordinary F4 completed, but the complete character-reduced equivariant solver was not implemented.
scope: The n7,r29 toy fixture and supplied solver paths.
assumptions: Subgroup and selector replay gates in the earlier packet.
not_implied: Equivariant F4 was tried end to end and failed.
lesson: A validated fixture is reusable infrastructure; it is not a test of an unimplemented solver.
next_discriminating_test: Implement one character block, reconstruct rows and compare full row spaces before complete-query experiments.
revisit_when: Implement one character block, reconstruct rows and compare full row spaces before complete-query experiments.
